finding: The source contains exactly one EXACT-DUPLICATE row per forest key.
evidence: LVWE 6550 rows over 6500 distinct (series_key, series_date) pairs: 100 duplicate rows across 50 groups, one per key, all on series_date 2026-04-22 with window_start 2026-04-16. All 50 groups carry an IDENTICAL actual_value and window_start. LVNE shows the same pattern.
impact: Real observation count per SSD key is 130 distinct dates, not 131 rows. Still far above the 50 threshold, so no key fails. Left in the raw file deliberately: raw means raw.
action_required_in: P4 must dedupe on (series_key, series_date) when building actuals_normalized. Because the duplicates are byte-identical, keep-first is safe and lossless.

finding: The 20 selected series per metric span only 10 distinct region keys, each appearing in both Consumed and Failover.
evidence: CPU: 20 series over 10 keys, 10 keys present in both scenarios. IOPS identical.
impact: Structurally valid because a series is (scenario, key), and the P2 rule of 10 Consumed + 10 Failover is satisfied. But geographic coverage is 10 regions, not 20. This is a selection-diversity weakness introduced in P2, not a data defect.
action_required_in: P4 decision: keep as is, or reselect to span 20 distinct regions across the two scenarios. The pool holds 30 CPU and 29 IOPS keys per scenario, so 20 distinct keys is achievable.

finding: min series_date is 2026-04-13, while P2A recorded a min date of 2026-04-07.
evidence: P2A measured MIN(Start_Date); P3 reports MIN(End_Date). The first window spans 2026-04-07 to 2026-04-13.
impact: Not a discrepancy. Different columns of the same row. Both are retained in the raw file as window_start and series_date.

finding: Neither actuals table carries any forecast column.
evidence: source_forecast_column is NOT_PRESENT_IN_SOURCE for all 40 CPU and IOPS series.
impact: Unlike SSD, which ships two external forecast baselines, CPU and IOPS will have only the 15 generated models with nothing external to compare against.
action_required_in: P5/P6 awareness. Accept for the MVP or source a baseline separately.

finding: actual_value_source_text was retained alongside the cast actual_value.
evidence: 0 rows where the source text is present but the cast is null, across both files.
impact: The varchar-to-float cast is auditable rather than trusted. Zero silent coercion.
action_required_in: P4 may drop the provenance column once the cast is accepted.
